author: ojiudezue
title: Overnight 11-16: two perimeter promises measured, one dormant by construction, one silently broken
summary: The 'that was Jaya' follow-up can never arm (no camera is both perimeter and door), and the circling escalation is always swallowed by NM dedup because severity was never in the dedup key.
why: Both were checked by tracing the producer forward to the action, not by waiting for an event. The follow-up gates on D10.5, which runs only for dual-role cameras; dual_role_cameras is [] on this house, so zero follow-ups was zero eligible events, not a defect. The circling exemption was designed on the belief that NM dedups on (coordinator, title, location, severity); the key is coordinator:title:location, the perimeter title is constant and location is the camera sensor, so an escalation hop on the same camera within the window is dropped. Live gate rows since 11-14: 8 of 8 exemption hops with a same-camera page in the prior 5 min left no notification row, one CRITICAL; 3 of 5 without a prior row were delivered. The pin test asserted severities on a mocked notify and never ran the dedup, so it passed on a false premise.
implications: PERIMETER-IDENTITY-FOLLOWUP-1 closed; its dormancy folded as a PICK into PERIMETER-FP-GATES-DISPOSE-1 (make a door camera dual-role or not). PERIMETER-CIRCLING-HOP-SEVERITY-COLLIDE-1 escalated: recommended fix is a perimeter-local title for escalation dispatches, tested against the real NM dedup, rather than touching the shared dedup key.
revisit_trigger: A door camera is added to perimeter_cameras (follow-up and D10.5 become live), or the circling fix ships (re-run the exemption-row vs notification_log join).
